edition_introduction: This catch-up edition records source-backed Gaza developments that were identified through historical review after they were missed or not represented in the regular public dispatch sequence.
retrospective_disclosure: These developments were recovered through historical review after being previously missed or not represented in the regular public dispatch sequence, and are being published retrospectively on Sept. 3, 2026. Event dates, source dates, attribution, and uncertainty are preserved from the reviewed evidence; this catch-up does not represent that these items were published on their original event dates.
